props.label: Standard Quantity (Auto)
props.description: The Standard Quantity - or Standard Production Quantity is to be used when the PLC production tag provides a signal to "record" the standard quantity will be used as the intpu value for the production quantity. Alternatively, the value can be provided by the PLC explicity, as a Part Counter Tag input value OR you can use a Cycle Counter Tag input (last known value) as the production quantity to be utilized. If no values are provided, 0 will be used, unless you implement other custom logic.
